findings.title: Use of Prototype Pollution susceptible object assignment
findings.description: The `assign` function at src/scimPatch.ts:437 iterates over arbitrary user-controlled property keys and directly assigns them to the target object. Because there is no validation of the key names, an attacker can pass '__proto__', 'constructor', or 'prototype' to manipulate the object's prototype.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a malicious SCIM PATCH operation where the 'value' object contains a key named '__proto__'.
Inject a payload such as 'polluted': 'yes' into the '__proto__' key.
Submit the patch request to the application.
The global object structure is modified, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE) or Denial of Service (DoS).
findings.impact: Remote code execution or complete application compromise via prototype pollution.
